import sys

def can_put(s, p, d):
    return s[p] == 'X' or s[p] == '_' or s[p] == d

def put(s, p, d):
    if s[p] == 'X':
        replace(s, d)
    else:
        s[p] = d

def replace(s, d):
    for i in range(len(s)):
        if s[i] == 'X':
            s[i] = d

def possible(s):
    p = 1
    if s[0] == '0':
        return 0
    if s[0] == '_':
        p *= 9
    elif s[0] == 'X':
        p *= 9
        replace(s, '1')
    for i in range(1, len(s)):
        if s[i] == '_':
            p *= 10
        elif s[i] == 'X':
            p *= 10
            replace(s, '1')
    return p

def main():
    s_input = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    s = list(s_input)
    ans = 0
    n = len(s)
    if n == 1:
        if s[0] in ['0', '_', 'X']:
            ans = 1
    else:
        if not (s[n - 1] == 'X' and s[n - 2] == 'X'):
            # put 25
            if can_put(s, n - 1, '5') and can_put(s, n - 2, '2'):
                s1 = s.copy()
                put(s1, n - 1, '5')
                put(s1, n - 2, '2')
                ans += possible(s1)
            # put 50
            if can_put(s, n - 1, '0') and can_put(s, n - 2, '5'):
                s1 = s.copy()
                put(s1, n - 1, '0')
                put(s1, n - 2, '5')
                ans += possible(s1)
            # put 75
            if can_put(s, n - 1, '5') and can_put(s, n - 2, '7'):
                s1 = s.copy()
                put(s1, n - 1, '5')
                put(s1, n - 2, '7')
                ans += possible(s1)
        # put 00
        if s[n - 1] == 'X' and s[n - 2] == 'X':
            s1 = s.copy()
            put(s1, n - 1, '0')
            ans += possible(s1)
        elif can_put(s, n - 1, '0') and can_put(s, n - 2, '0'):
            s1 = s.copy()
            put(s1, n - 1, '0')
            put(s1, n - 2, '0')
            ans += possible(s1)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
